pages.name: Fleet output
pages.storyNote: Where the installed capacity sits and how much of it the fleet actually converts.

visuals.title: Installed capacity (MW)
visuals.altText: Combined nameplate capacity of every wind farm in megawatts.

visuals.title: Power output (kW)
visuals.altText: Total recorded power output across the fleet in kilowatts.

visuals.title: Average capacity factor
visuals.altText: Mean share of nameplate capacity actually delivered.

visuals.subtext: A farm can hold the most megawatts and still convert the least. Read capacity factor alongside installed capacity, never instead of it.

visuals.title: Where the fleet is sited
visuals.altText: World map with a bubble per wind farm, sized by installed capacity in megawatts.

visuals.title: Which farms deliver the output
visuals.altText: Recorded power output for each wind farm, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Does generator type change the output
visuals.altText: Recorded power output grouped by nacelle generator type, sorted from most to least.

pages.name: Reliability
pages.storyNote: What the fleet costs to keep turning, and which turbines absorb that cost.

visuals.title: Critical alerts
visuals.altText: Number of alerts raised at critical severity.

visuals.title: Maintenance cost
visuals.altText: Total maintenance spend across all maintenance events.

visuals.title: Average duration (hours)
visuals.altText: Mean hours spent on a maintenance event.

visuals.subtext: Maintenance spend usually concentrates on a handful of turbines. Those are the candidates for condition monitoring, not the fleet average.

visuals.title: Which turbines absorb the maintenance cost
visuals.altText: Maintenance cost for each turbine, sorted from most to least expensive.

visuals.title: Which sensor types raise the alerts
visuals.altText: Alert count by sensor type, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Who performs the maintenance
visuals.altText: Maintenance event count grouped by technician certification level.

visuals.title: Turbine detail
visuals.altText: Maintenance event count and cost for every turbine, with its status.
